data.name: Anjan
data.gender_notes: Anjan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'anjana', which means 'delight' or 'joy'. It is also associated with the goddess Anjani, who is the mother of Hanuman. In Hindu mythology, Anjan represents purity, strength, and devotion. The name Anjan carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anjan usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the spirit of joy and delight, symbolizing the inner happiness and contentment that comes from living in harmony with the divine.
data.etymology: Anjan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anjan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
